text: The number of arrangements of six identical balls in three identical bins is ______.
solution: With identical balls and identical bins only the multiset of bin sizes matters: partitions of 6 into at most 3 parts. Listing them: 6; 5+1; 4+2; 4+1+1; 3+3; 3+2+1; 2+2+2. That is 7. If the bins were distinct the answer would be C(8,2) = 28.
source_label: GATE 2022 CS solution set with key printed as 7; question also in the official paper at gate2026.iitg.ac.in
